component.title: TreeView
component.purpose: A navigable hierarchical surface for files and structured resources.

states.description: Expanded folders reveal their children with clear hierarchy and selection affordances.
Collapsed folders preserve context and expose an explicit disclosure control.
An empty tree explains that there is nothing to display.

claims.statement: The surface exposes a named tree with level-aware treeitems and groups for nested content.
Arrow, Home, End, Enter, and Space keys provide predictable navigation, disclosure, and selection behavior.
Long labels truncate without collapsing the hierarchy or introducing horizontal overflow.
The empty state is announced through a status region.
